note: Underground galleries (MIN-A, OD-29; docs/build17/MIN_A_ARCHITECTURE.md), read by Underground (game/scripts/core/underground.gd). Each lies under the surface rock that holds its portal's door; the shape comes from the world seed. Seam amounts are the village map's own per-seam amount for the ore unless 'amount' is given. Tiles are values of the village's atlases (atlas * 100000 + tile id, as in village.json): floor the paid atlas's grey cobbled stone (ROCK_SLAB), wall the hill top's own rock (ROCK_FILL, tools/build_village.py::rock_top).
